items.reason: Glioblastoma is named in the title ("Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Patients"), but the inclusion criterion admits "newly diagnosed high-grade glioma" and the condition is "Glioma, Malignant", so several glioma types are eligible with GBM named (C7 allows the title).

Poly-ICLC is registered only inside the vaccine interventions ("NeoPep Vaccine1 plus Poly-ICLC") and "will be used as immunomodulator with all vaccinations"; it has no own arm or outcome, so under D30-R4 it is part of the excluded vaccine therapy.
Vaccine adjuvant given only with the NeoPep vaccines ("Poly-ICLC（500ug）will be used as immunomodulator with all vaccinations"); not tested in its own right.

items.reason: Inclusion "Patients with newly diagnosed high-grade glioma" admits non-GBM high-grade gliomas, while the title names glioblastoma; this fits mixed_glioma_gbm_named rather than gbm_only. Inclusion either way.
Only non-vaccine agent besides the temozolomide backbone is the vaccine adjuvant poly-ICLC, which D30-R4 makes part of the excluded vaccine therapy.
Adjuvant registered within each vaccine intervention and given "with all vaccinations"; no own arm or outcome.
With poly-ICLC excluded (D30-R4) the trial has no candidate, so regimen is not_applicable and no partners are recorded.

The only biomarker endpoint is vaccine immunogenicity ("induced T-cell immune responses after vaccinations with NeoPep Vaccine1and 2"); once poly-ICLC is not a candidate there is no candidate whose target engagement could be measured.
